name: Redragon BK 7114 Scissor Low-Profile Slim Dual-Mode Wireless and Bluetooth Type-C Rechargeable Ultra-Quiet Keyboard
shortDescription: Redragon BK7114 Scissor Low-Profile Slim Wireless Keyboard White Grey (96% Compact 98-Keys Layout / Ultra-Quiet Scissor Switches / Dual-Mode Bluetooth & 2.4GHz Wireless Connectivity / Multi-Device Pair up to 4 Device
descriptionHtml:
Redragon BK7114 Scissor Low-Profile Slim Wireless Keyboard White Grey (96% Compact 98-Keys Layout / Ultra-Quiet Scissor Switches / Dual-Mode Bluetooth & 2.4GHz Wireless Connectivity / Multi-Device Pair up to 4 Devices / Windows & Mac Easy Toggle / USB Type-C Rechargeable / 1 Year Warranty)

Upgrade your office and productivity setup with the Redragon BK7114 low-profile wireless keyboard in an elegant White Grey mixed-color aesthetic, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with a 1-Year Warranty. Designed for silent typing and maximum comfort, it features high-precision scissor switches that shorten key travel distance for rapid, quiet keystrokes. With its tactical 96% layout housing 98 keys including a full number pad, dual-mode wireless connectivity (Bluetooth 3.0/5.0 + 2.4GHz USB receiver), and the ability to seamlessly connect and toggle between up to 4 devices across Windows and macOS, the BK7114 delivers outstanding versatility and battery efficiency for modern workspaces.
